changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each model call gets one ledger row: the run and claim that made it, whether it still waits for its end, the model kind, the practice of a practice script call, and when it started. A row from before keeps its run empty, ends, and starts at its own date. One attempt can now have many rows, so the key of one row per attempt goes before any row moves.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE llm_usage_event SET model_kind = CASE source_type WHEN 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_DECISION' THEN 'DECISION' WHEN 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_EMBEDDING' THEN 'EMBEDDING' WHEN 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_RERANKING' THEN 'RERANKING' ELSE 'CHAT' END, started_at = occurred_at, initial_pricing_state = pricing_state;

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The measurements that the previous release had not written to the ledger yet, because their attempts still ran, become ledger rows: one for the review's own model, one for each practice and model kind of its practice scripts, and one for each turn attempt. Each row keeps the frozen model and rates, and waits UNPRICED for the repricing pass, which prices it from them. The chat calls of practice scripts are already in the review's own total.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO llm_usage_event (id, workspace_id, job_type, source_type, source_id, source_attempt, review_id, model_kind, practice_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, search_units, total_calls, unreported_calls, cost_usd, pricing_state, funding_source, initial_pricing_state, applied_price_id, applied_workspace_model_id, applied_per_1m_input_usd, applied_per_1m_output_usd, applied_per_1m_cache_read_usd, applied_per_1m_cache_write_usd, usage_provenance, measurement_verification, started_at, occurred_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), m.workspace_id, 'PRACTICE_REVIEW', m.source_type, m.job_id, m.attempt, j.review_id, m.model_kind, m.practice_id, c.model, m.input_tokens, m.output_tokens, m.cache_read_tokens, m.cache_write_tokens, m.reasoning_tokens, m.search_units, m.calls, m.unreported, CASE WHEN c.pricing_state = 'NO_CHARGE' AND m.unreported = 0 THEN 0 END, CASE WHEN c.pricing_state = 'NO_CHARGE' AND m.unreported = 0 THEN 'NO_CHARGE' ELSE 'UNPRICED' END, COALESCE(c.funding_source, 'INSTANCE'), COALESCE(c.pricing_state, 'UNPRICED'), c.applied_price_id, c.applied_workspace_model_id, c.applied_per_1m_input_usd, c.applied_per_1m_output_usd, c.applied_per_1m_cache_read_usd, c.applied_per_1m_cache_write_usd, 'PROXY', CASE WHEN m.unreported = 0 THEN 'VERIFIED' ELSE 'UNVERIFIABLE' END, COALESCE(u.occurred_at, j.execution_started_at, j.started_at, now()), COALESCE(u.occurred_at, j.execution_started_at, j.started_at, now()) FROM (SELECT u.workspace_id, u.job_id, u.attempt, 'REVIEW_JOB' AS source_type, 'CHAT' AS model_kind, NULL::bigint AS practice_id, u.proxy_input_tokens AS input_tokens, u.proxy_output_tokens AS output_tokens, u.proxy_cache_read_tokens AS cache_read_tokens, u.proxy_cache_write_tokens AS cache_write_tokens, u.proxy_reasoning_tokens AS reasoning_tokens, 0::bigint AS search_units, u.proxy_calls + COALESCE(s.unreported, 0) AS calls, COALESCE(s.unreported, 0) AS unreported FROM review_job_attempt_usage u LEFT JOIN (SELECT job_id, attempt, workspace_id, SUM(calls - reported_calls) AS unreported FROM review_job_script_usage WHERE model_kind = 'CHAT' GROUP BY job_id, attempt, workspace_id) s ON s.job_id = u.job_id AND s.attempt = u.attempt AND s.workspace_id = u.workspace_id WHERE u.proxy_calls + COALESCE(s.unreported, 0) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT x.workspace_id, x.job_id, x.attempt, 'PRACTICE_SCRIPT_' || x.model_kind, x.model_kind, x.practice_id, x.input_tokens, x.output_tokens, x.cache_read_tokens, x.cache_write_tokens, 0, x.search_units, x.calls, x.calls - x.reported_calls FROM review_job_script_usage x WHERE x.model_kind <> 'CHAT' AND x.calls > 0) m JOIN review_job j ON j.id = m.job_id AND j.workspace_id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN review_job_attempt_usage u ON u.job_id = m.job_id AND u.attempt = m.attempt AND u.workspace_id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN review_job_attempt_charge c ON c.job_id = m.job_id AND c.attempt = m.attempt AND c.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND c.model_kind = m.model_kind WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM llm_usage_event e WHERE e.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND e.source_id = m.job_id AND e.source_attempt = m.attempt AND e.source_type <> 'MENTOR_TURN'); INSERT INTO llm_usage_event (id, workspace_id, job_type, source_type, source_id, source_attempt, model_kind, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_calls, cost_usd, pricing_state, funding_source, initial_pricing_state, applied_price_id, applied_workspace_model_id, applied_per_1m_input_usd, applied_per_1m_output_usd, applied_per_1m_cache_read_usd, applied_per_1m_cache_write_usd, usage_provenance, measurement_verification, started_at, occurred_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), m.workspace_id, 'MENTOR_TURN', 'MENTOR_TURN', m.turn_id, m.attempt, 'CHAT', m.model, m.input_tokens, m.output_tokens, m.cache_read_tokens, m.cache_write_tokens, m.reasoning_tokens, GREATEST(1, m.calls), CASE WHEN m.pricing_state = 'NO_CHARGE' THEN 0 END, CASE WHEN m.pricing_state = 'NO_CHARGE' THEN 'NO_CHARGE' ELSE 'UNPRICED' END, m.funding_source, m.pricing_state, m.applied_price_id, m.applied_workspace_model_id, m.applied_per_1m_input_usd, m.applied_per_1m_output_usd, m.applied_per_1m_cache_read_usd, m.applied_per_1m_cache_write_usd, 'PROXY', 'VERIFIED', COALESCE(m.occurred_at, t.started_at, now()), COALESCE(m.occurred_at, t.started_at, now()) FROM mentor_turn_attempt_usage m LEFT JOIN mentor_turn t ON t.id = m.turn_id AND t.workspace_id = m.workspace_id WHERE m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens + m.cache_read_tokens + m.cache_write_tokens > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM llm_usage_event e WHERE e.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND e.source_type = 'MENTOR_TURN' AND e.source_id = m.turn_id AND e.source_attempt = m.attempt);

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An open call always has the live claim that made it. A row keeps its accounting when its run is deleted, as when a turn is deleted, so the run reference is cleared then; the run's deletion settles the calls it left open first. The repricing pass reads every month, oldest first, through a partial index of exactly its work list.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The measurements of each attempt and the running counters of jobs and turns go: the ledger's call rows hold them now.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each call holds the most it can cost at its frozen rates: its request bytes and its output limit. Spend reads count this upper bound while the call is open or was not measured. Rows from before keep no bound.
